description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Appointed Dr. Chandana Weerasekara as the Chairman and Dr. M. A. M. Muneer as Vice Chairman and 08 other members to Interim Homoeopathic Medical Council w.e.f. 21.10.2016
reasoning: This gazette contains both named individuals (Dr. Chandana Weerasekara, Dr. Muhammad Abubakar Muhammed Muneer, etc.) and their specific appointments to roles within the Interim Homoeopathic Medical Council (Chairman, Vice Chairman, Member). The appointments are made under statutory authority (Homoeopathy Act, No. 10 of 2016) and are signed by a specific government official (Dr. Rajitha Senarathna, Minister of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine), making this a hybrid gazette that includes both personnel changes and the governmental/regulatory context of those appointments.
